newsitem.title: USA: Nash Finch to buy Sunshine grocery stores.
newsitem.headline: Nash Finch to buy Sunshine grocery stores.

text.p: Nash Finch Co said on Thursday that it entered into a series of agreements to buy the assets of Sunshine's retail grocery stores in Sioux Falls, Mitchell and Yankton, S.D.
Terms of the transaction, expected to be completed in late October, were not disclosed.

In a related move, Nash Finch and Gordy's Inc of Worthington, Minn., said they formed a partnership that will result in joint ownership of the Sunshine stores. Gordy's, which owns and operates five retail food stores in Minnesota, will be operating partner of the jointly owned stores.
